design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (hosting_plans_and_billing, env_0076), rework round 2. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[4,5]; hosting_ext_auto_renew_refund took 4 factors, hosting_ext_early_renewal took 5.

WHY A GOOD TEST. The customer only says his Pro plan is set to a three-year term and he would rather renew it for one year, paying through PayPal. The early renewal rule says 'An early renewal is not billed until the plan's term start date is on or before today.' The 2026-10-15 auto-renewal (an auto-renew charge, so priced by base with the scheduled 36-month term change) already moved the plan into a 36-month term starting 2026-10-22, so the agent must find that charge, see it is inside the 15-day auto-renew refund window, price the refund with its four keep-backs, refund it (roll-back to 2025-10-22..2026-10-22 with the 12-month billing term restored and auto-renew off), and only then price the one-year renewal and hand it to the customer to pay at checkout.

OWNER RULING. The early renewal is the holder's own payment at Harborline's checkout (coordinator owner_ruling (b)): he pays through the collective's PayPal, a method not on file, and the rule states the payment is the holder's own act after the agent quotes it. The refund is a support act (agent).

SCOPE. Task 0 holds the overdue renewal and the Cloud 8 upgrade. Task 1 claims hosting_ext_auto_renew_refund (refund_hosting_auto_renewal_84b3efde, agent) and hosting_ext_early_renewal (pay_hosting_renewal_early_31233d6b, user). The two renewal rules split base hosting_renewal's pricing sentence by disjoint record tests and both tails name the same leftover cases (auto-renew charges, downgrade-applying renewals, early renewals of plans with a scheduled term change), which stay under base.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. root hosting_ext_early_renewal <- hosting_ext_auto_renew_refund. Edge value_input, gate early_new_term_months, form state, negated 'not ... until'. Four-point test: connective; XX = term_start_date vs today; no tool/id/code token; hard requirement on that date. Unique resolver: renewal writes move term_start_date forward; only the refund's roll-back moves it back. Unresolved at frozen_time: initial_state.hosting_holdings.0d182581-ad90-4c49-83b1-ffdf2a10d7e1.term_start_date = 2026-10-22 > 2026-10-19. Deletion sensitivity: skipping the refund prices the early renewal on the 36-month billing term with no early renewal credit (549.24). user_scenario never mentions the auto-renew charge or a refund.

FACTOR CARD - hosting_ext_auto_renew_refund (baseline: the full amount of the most recent auto_renew line): rf_processor_fee (parameter: card 2.9 / PayPal 3.49 percent of the line when refunded after its charge date, nothing for a same-day void); the rule books only refunds of card- or PayPal-paid lines back to that method (credit refunds belong to the account charter's refund-credit rule); rf_handling_age (parameter: 4 days -> 9.00); rf_change_reversal (parameter: applied term_change on the line's period_start -> 15.00); rf_commitment_share (method: 36-month line -> one month at the tier's monthly_rate_no_commitment; 24-month -> 12 x (renewal_rate_12mo - renewal_rate_24mo); 12-month -> none).
FACTOR CARD - hosting_ext_early_renewal (baseline: regular price for billing_term_months, 12 after the roll-back): early_reseller_discount (parameter, account: Bronze 10); early_advance_credit (parameter, auto-renew off AND days to term end: 10.00 from 30 days ahead, 4.00 under 30, none with auto-renew on); early_domain_bundle (method, domain: Harborline credits the bundled domain's yearly renewal - a bundled registration whose latest renewal line carries no refund and no later restore -> that line's amount per year renewed, any other active bundled registration -> its TLD's renewal_price, none -> 0; jandreauweb.com renewed 2026-09-22 at 17.64 here); early_mail_bundle (parameter, email: Mail Starter, 3 seats -> 10.00); early_cert_bundle (parameter, ssl: the active DV installed on the plan -> 6.00; the expired 2024 certificate is the decoy). Credits never take more than half the discounted price.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Refund write: auto-renew refund window (charge 2026-10-15 + 15 days, inclusive -> 2026-10-30; today is day 4), now stated in the extended refund rule; money_back_window and money_back_quota concern money-back refunds with an immediate cancellation and do not block this auto-renew refund; refund_line_once (no refund references the line). Destination: original payment method (card), the line was not paid from credit and the customer does not elect credit, so no account trigger fires. Renewal write: renewable_plan (active); downgrade_fits (no downgrade request, only an applied term change).

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Plan 0d182581-ad90-4c49-83b1-ffdf2a10d7e1; refunded object = auto_renew line 007ace28-3c3b-4cb6-9198-1467118b0a79; restored term = the 2025-10-15 line's period and 12-month length; the renewal line starts 2026-10-22.

SEED. Cross rows priced by their own charters: .com domain jandreauweb.com bundled free 2024-10-22 (0.00, bundle_credit; .com is free_with_hosting_eligible and Pro carries the free domain on a 12-month term), auto-renewed 2025-09-22 (17.98 + 0.20 = 18.18, Business 0 percent, card) and 2026-09-22 (17.98 x 0.97 = 17.44 + 0.20 = 17.64, Bronze, from credit; ledger apply -17.64; balance 482.36 < the 36-month auto-renew); the primary domain jandreauweb.ca is registered elsewhere, so the mail subscription has no Harborline domain link; Mail Starter 3 seats 71.64 per year (Business 0 percent on 2025-03-03 and 2026-02-24); SSL DV purchases 19.99 (2024-10-25, Business 0 percent) and 17.99 (2026-06-10, Bronze 10 percent), certificate validity 200 days, free installation on the Harborline plan; deposit 500.00 on 2026-03-25 qualifying Bronze from 2026-04-01. Hosting: 107.88, 263.88, 582.88. Uptime reports were removed in round 2.

PERSONA. Sheepish, over-explaining small-shop owner; volunteers the one-year wish and PayPal; identity on request; consents to undoing/refunding when told; refund back to the card; completes the 12-month PayPal checkout himself; ends after the receipt.

STANDARD SOLUTION. locate/verify -> read plan, charges, change requests, account, ledger, bundled domain and its charges, email and its charges, certificates and their charges -> refund against 007ace28-3c3b-4cb6-9198-1467118b0a79 -> hand over the 12-month renewal (PayPal). Verification: /tmp/hosting_plans_and_billing_0076/t1/plan.py, every factor MOVES.
user_scenario: You are Theo Jandreau, who runs Jandreau Web Collective Inc., a three-person web shop in Vancouver. You are a little sheepish on this call and tend to explain yourself more than needed, but you are clear about what you want. Your Harborline Pro hosting plan for jandreauweb.ca is set to a three-year term, which you set up over the summer when you thought you would keep the site for years; now you are not sure the collective will last that long, so you want the plan renewed for just one year instead. You will pay that one-year renewal yourself, on this call, through PayPal at Harborline's checkout when the support person sets it up for you; you never want this one on a card. Open with roughly: "Hi, I'm Theo from Jandreau Web Collective. Our Pro plan for jandreauweb.ca is set to a three-year term and I'd really rather renew it for just one year - can we do that?" You are not asking for anything else. Only when asked for identity details do you give them: your contact email is theo@jandreauweb.ca and your phone number is 6045550117; if a third detail is needed, your support PIN is 271904. You do not know any internal reference numbers. If the agent explains that something already on the plan has to be undone or refunded first, you say that is fine and they may go ahead and do it; if they ask where money should go back to, you say back to the card it came from. If they ask how long the new renewal should be, you say one year. If they ask how you will pay it, you say through PayPal at the checkout, because the company card ending 2468 on file is only for the automatic charges and you keep manual purchases on the collective's PayPal. When the agent hands the one-year renewal over for you to pay, you complete it yourself with the plan, the amount, the twelve-month term and the payment method the agent gives you, paying through PayPal; you never make up an amount of your own. If a number sounds odd you only ask them to double-check it against the account and accept their answer. Once you can see the receipt for your one-year renewal, you thank them and end the call.

edges.condition: hosting_holdings.term_start_date of the plan is on or before the date of today, which holds once the auto-renew line that paid a term not yet begun carries its refund and the plan has been rolled back to the term paid before it.
edges.policy_source: An early renewal is not billed until the plan's term start date is on or before today.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The auto-renew of 2026-10-15 already moved the plan into a 36-month term that starts 2026-10-22, three days after today (2026-10-19); no refund line exists against that charge.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The refund write books a refund line against the 2026-10-15 auto_renew line and sets term_start_date 2025-10-22, term_end_date 2026-10-22, auto_renew false; the term start is then before today, billing_term_months returns to 12 and auto-renew is off, so the early renewal prices the 12-month term with the early renewal credit instead of the 36-month term.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge: the early renewal 'is not billed until the plan's term start date is on or before today', and only the refund's rollback brings that about; the reverse order would stack a 12-month term after the 36-month one (priced on the 36-month billing term) and the refund would then roll back the wrong term.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the refund and pricing the early renewal on the opening world gives 549.24 (36-month billing term 647.64 less 10 percent = 582.88, no early renewal credit because auto-renew is on, less 33.64 of bundle credits) instead of 199.85; the terminal state also keeps the 36-month term and no refund line.
